SELECT TRC.TRADE_ID, TRC.RULE_ID, TRC.FOLLOWED, TR.RULE_CONTENT FROM TRADE_RULE_CHECK TRC
JOIN TRADE_RULE TR ON TRC.RULE_ID = TR.RULE_ID
JOIN TRADE T ON TRC.TRADE_ID = T.TRADE_ID
WHERE TRC.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND T.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND TR.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
ORDER BY TRC.RULE_ID
